notes: Both MAUI and C++ show the grey canvas with a small red square in the top-left corner, and all transform sliders below (RotateTransform, ScaleTransform, SkewTransform, TranslateTransform).
MAUI canvas area is taller/larger than C++ canvas area — the grey preview box is noticeably bigger in MAUI.
All slider labels and default values (Rotation: 0, CenterX: 0, CenterY: 0, ScaleX: 1.00, ScaleY: 1.00, SkewX: 0) match correctly.
Dark mode: MAUI has white slider tracks and white toggle pills for the sliders; C++ sliders show white toggle pills but darker track — minor cosmetic difference.
